reason: £280 with no tyres is more than I'd pay when I can usually find a used set on Marketplace for £150-200 and haggle down from there. The view-first and refund terms are good, but I'd still want it cheaper.
objection: £280 and no tyres, so I'd be paying for tyres on top. Also a new seller with no reviews, so I don't know if the refurb is any good.
would_change_my_mind: Around £200 a set, or tyres with decent tread included at £280.
